'''Koochoo''' was an [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series labor droid]] owned by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] fence [[Krezo Wasanti]].<ref name="MPQ" />

==Biography==
Koochoo served as the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for Wasanti during his dealing as a fence for the criminal organization known as the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. He was programmed to be completely loyal and unable to intentionally cause harm to his owner. This protocol did not apply to others, and Wasanti had no qualms about using Koochoo to hold off enemies while he escaped unharmed.<ref name="MPQ" />

Like other ASP-series droids, Koochoo was only capable of speaking the worlds "Affirmative" and "Negative," which he spoke in a mechanized [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. His name meant "idiot" or "moron" in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] language.<ref name="MPQ" />
